title: Carrie
author: Stephen King
summary: A shy teenage girl, raised by a zealously religious mother, discovers she has telekinetic powers just as her classmates plan a cruel prank. The story is told partly through news reports and later accounts.
readIf: you want a short, sharp horror novel about cruelty, isolation and what happens when the bullied fight back.
skipIf: you find school bullying or religious abuse hard to read about.

pairings.reason: A far lighter story of a girl with strange powers and unkind adults, written for younger readers.
Another story that combines a girl, faith and supernatural force, in a more intense form.
A realistic, quiet take on being ostracised in high school.
